## WorkerThreadRpc class

\[LOW-LEVEL\] Handles JSON-RPC style communication between threads.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class WorkerThreadRpc 
```

## Remarks

Low-level internal infrastructure. Used by [WorkerThreadInit](./worker-thread.workerthreadinit.md) and [WorkerThreadLaunch](./worker-thread.workerthreadlaunch.md) under the hood — you rarely need to touch it.

Uses simple JSON-RPC style messages with `id`<!-- -->, `method`<!-- -->, `params`<!-- -->, `result`<!-- -->, `error`<!-- -->.
